tasks.subject: Task 13: Adopt WithTx in 6 manual-transaction repos
tasks.description:
**Correction (2026-09-02, found during execution):** user_pmcs/sync/repository_impl.go's loadDeltaSnapshot uses RepeatableRead+ReadOnly TxOptions for 3 sequential SELECTs needing one consistent snapshot. db.WithTx (Task 12) only supports default isolation -- migrating would silently downgrade correctness. Corrected: 5 of 6 files migrate; user_pmcs/sync stays on manual BeginTx permanently, documented with an inline comment. db.WithTx is NOT extended to support custom TxOptions for this one caller.

**Goal:** Replace manual Begin/Commit/Rollback boilerplate in 5 files with db.WithTx: pmcs_sbs_progress, shops/messages, shops/vehicles, user_general, user_saves/categories. user_pmcs/sync gets a documenting comment only, no functional change.

**Files:**
- Modify: api/pmcs_sbs_progress/repository_impl.go
- Modify: api/shops/messages/repository_impl.go
- Modify: api/shops/vehicles/repository_impl.go
- Modify: api/user_general/repository_impl.go
- Modify: api/user_pmcs/sync/repository_impl.go (comment only)
- Modify: api/user_saves/categories/repository_impl.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 5 files' manual Begin/BeginTx calls replaced with db.WithTx.
- [ ] user_pmcs/sync/repository_impl.go's loadDeltaSnapshot keeps manual BeginTx with custom TxOptions, unchanged functionally, with an explanatory comment.
- [ ] Each migrated method has a passing rollback-on-error test (deadlock technique acceptable where no natural constraint-violation scenario exists, e.g. ON DELETE CASCADE tables).
- [ ] Inner callback error-wrapping text preserved where tests depend on it; outer begin/commit wrapper text changing to db.WithTx's generic text is expected and fine.

**Verify:** go test -p 1 ./tests/pmcs_sbs_progress/... ./tests/shops/... ./tests/user_pmcs/... ./tests/user_saves/... -v -> all pass. (tests/user_general/ does not exist as a directory; DeleteUser is covered from tests/user_pmcs instead.)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["api/pmcs_sbs_progress/repository_impl.go", "api/shops/messages/repository_impl.go", "api/shops/vehicles/repository_impl.go", "api/user_general/repository_impl.go", "api/user_pmcs/sync/repository_impl.go", "api/user_saves/categories/repository_impl.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test -p 1 ./tests/pmcs_sbs_progress/... ./tests/shops/... ./tests/user_pmcs/... ./tests/user_saves/... -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["5 of 6 files migrated to db.WithTx (all except user_pmcs/sync)", "user_pmcs/sync documented, not migrated", "rollback-on-error tests pass for each migrated method", "inner callback error text preserved where tests depend on it"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
